_about: One line per Banking77 intent, written by hand from the label name and a look at a few training messages. Column A (the LLM) sees these in its prompt, and column C (Fern) sees them as tool descriptions. No message from either split appears here. `tool` is the label as a valid function name: two Banking77 labels are not ('Refund_not_showing_up', 'reverted_card_payment?').
